name: Gray-Scott spots Turing普适稳态
description: Gray-Scott RD模型 (Pearson 1993 Science 261 189) F=0.035, k=0.065参数下产生稳态spot pattern,2D L=192格点,中心多种子IC,8000步显式FTCS积分。Turing peak在k=14.5 (波长~13 px),映射到0.5 km/px下λ=6.6 km,落入reaction_diffusion_steady_state_class预设lambda band [1.5, 8.0] km。S(k)谱exponent α≈5.16 (peak后陡降),local peakiness ratio 10.33 (远超阈值2.0)。null discrimination成功 (white noise / linear gradient / shuffled都被拒绝)。验证条目编号Wave 2A reaction-diffusion-steady-state。

name: Gray-Scott mazes波形独立子类
description: Gray-Scott RD同一动力学family,不同参数 (F=0.029, k=0.057) 产生labyrinth/maze形态稳态,Turing peak在k=15.5 (波长~12 px → λ=6.2 km @ 0.5 km/px)。与spot regime相比波长接近 (Δλ仅0.43 km) 但形态学完全不同,验证Turing普适类的λ尺度不变性:同一物理机制 (activator-inhibitor diffusion ratio Du/Dv=2) 在不同非线性饱和下产生spots vs stripes/mazes但保持相近Turing wavelength。重要isomorphism信号:同一class内形态学变化不必伴随λ变化。

name: Ornstein-Zernike相关长度从S(k)拟合
description: 稳态噪声驱动反应-扩散方程 (D∇²-k)T = -η的Fokker-Planck稳态解给出协方差C(r) ∝ K_0(r/λ),即Ornstein-Zernike Lorentzian频谱S(k) = A/(k² + 1/λ²) (Risken 1989 §5)。从该频谱通过 1/S(k) vs k² 的线性拟合可unbiased地恢复λ,适用范围λ_px ∈ [3, L/8] (sweep验证recovery精度1.0-1.4x输入值)。对比autocorrelation的纯指数拟合 (exp(-r/λ)) 系统性低估λ约2-5倍 (因实际衰减是Bessel K_0(r/λ),非纯exponential)。结构同构KB中作为diffusive correlation length标准提取协议。

name: 2D Bessel K0格林函数小r对数渐近
description: 稳态2D点源screened扩散方程 (D∇²-k)T = -Qδ(r) 解析解 T(r) = (Q/2πD) K_0(r/λ) (Carslaw-Jaeger 1959 §10.3)。小r极限 K_0(r/λ) ~ -ln(r/2λ) - γ_Euler,即log-radial decay (Wolpert 1969 J Theor Biol 25 1 French-flag morphogen的同一机制)。大r极限 K_0(r/λ) ~ sqrt(π λ/(2r)) exp(-r/λ),给出characteristic length cutoff。Verification: λ_phys=3.286 km closed-form (D=1000 m²/s, k=1/3h) 域中radial log-fit R²=0.726 > 0.70阈值。本KB条目记录两种渐近regime及其各自identification metric。

name: UHI梯度Oke-1973物理参数化
description: Oke 1973 Atmos Env 7 769城市热岛effective parameter范围: 湍流扩散系数D ~ 100-3000 m²/s (Stull 1988 ABL专著§5,稳定夜间-不稳定白天范围), 辐射对流relaxation rate k ~ 1/(1-10 h) (取决于水汽含量+地表反照率)。代表性中尺度: D=1000 m²/s, k=1/(3h) → λ=√(D/k)=3.3 km,落入brief预设的[1.5, 8.0] km band。结构同构KB中UHI类的典型 λ参数化锚点,适用Shanghai/Beijing/Guangzhou等mid-latitude大都市夏季夜晚 (steady-state假设,风速<3 m/s)。

name: 线性梯度null的Turing peak伪信号
description: 在S(k)中检测Turing peak时,纯线性梯度场 (no diffusion source) 的spectrum也会在box-scale附近出现peak (来自有限边界的cosine模式),global ratio与floor比较可达2-3。Solution: 增加local peakiness test (peak值/邻近±2,3,4个k bin均值) > 1.15,可成功区分真Turing peak (local ratio典型5-17) 与gradient artefact (local ratio ~1.0)。这是structural isomorphism null discrimination的关键技巧:仅靠global signal-to-floor ratio不足,必须要求peak shape narrow。本KB条目记录此方法及阈值标定。

name: RD-class isomorphism三模式同结构距离
description: 稳态反应扩散类内部三个独立spatial domain (Gray-Scott spots / GS mazes / UHI OZ random) 的cross-domain λ feature distance: A-B=0.43 km, A-C=2.82 km, B-C=2.39 km。Turing kinetic family内 (A, B) 距离最小,符合预期 (两者共享activator-inhibitor diffusion ratio,只差非线性饱和形态)。Diffusive linear damped (C) 与Turing kinetic family距离约2-3 km,处于同一order of magnitude (~5 km特征尺度),证明跨机制isomorphism在λ-feature space仍然有意义。但仅λ单feature不足以区分Turing vs OZ — 必须同时用power spectrum shape (peaked vs Lorentzian) 作为二元discriminator。

name: v0.4验证→v0.5 Landsat TIR follow-up计划
description: reaction_diffusion_steady_state_class v0.4验证用SYNTHETIC 3-domain完成CONFIRMED verdict (3 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 0 FAIL,跨domain λ mean±sd = 5.54±1.24 km in band)。v0.5 follow-up计划替换Domain C为real USGS Landsat 8/9 collection-2 thermal-infrared scenes (Shanghai/Beijing/Guangzhou summer-night 2015-2025, ~100m/px native, resample到300m匹配本验证pixel scale),用population-weighted centroid自动检测城市中心,filter wind<3 m/s保持steady-state,与ERA5-Land turbulent flux交叉验证D一致性。v0.4阻塞原因: 无rasterio + GEE Python auth offline不可用。Domain A/B (Gray-Scott pure physics) 保持作为canonical reference不必替换。
